req.title: Basic-auth rejects wrong password
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 401 and WWW-Authenticate: Basic when Basic-auth credentials are missing or wrong.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must return HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Basic when credentials are missing or wrong, and HTTP 200 with authenticated payload when correct. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — correct credentials yield 200 + JSON payload; (2) negative EP — wrong password yields exactly 401 + WWW-Authenticate header; (3) negative EP — missing Authorization header yields 401; (4) DT — correct user but wrong password (one field wrong); (5) BVA — empty string password vs correct password; (6) NEG — no credentials at all, asserting exact header value. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (not ranges), exact header strings, exact JSON field values, and both sides of the boolean condition in check_basic_auth (auth and auth.username == user and auth.password == passwd).

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_with_payload
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/testuser/testpass with correct Basic auth header
expected: JSON body contains authenticated=true and user='testuser'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-019: expected outcome — HTTP 2xx with expected payload
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

creds = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:testpass').decode('ascii')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}

def test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_with_payload():
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/testuser/testpass', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'testuser'

import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_wrong_password_returns_401_with_www_authenticate():
    wrong_creds = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:WRONGPASS').decode('ascii')
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {wrong_creds}'}
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/testuser/testpass', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 401
    www_auth = r.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate', '')
    assert www_auth.startswith('Basic')

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/alice/secret with correct Basic auth header
Assert status is not 401 and is exactly 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-019: EP + comparison-mutation — tests both sides: correct creds must NOT yield 401 and MUST yield 200
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

def test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_not_401():
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'alice:secret').decode('ascii')
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/alice/secret', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code != 401
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'alice'
    assert 'WWW-Authenticate' not in r.headers
